definitions: To open out (something) so that it covers a larger area.
To extend over a large or increasing area.
To become known about or discussed by many people.
To cause (something) to reach a wider area or a larger number of people.
To apply a substance to a surface in a thin layer.
examples: She spread the map on the table.
The fire spread rapidly through the forest.
News of the event spread quickly.
The disease spread from person to person.
He spread butter on his toast.
